method: SMT checks of single-session transition abstraction, release predicates and rights-set derivation
assumptions: Signatures and cryptographic bindings are abstract valid/invalid predicates.
Single immutable session ID; recovery issues another ID.

queries.name: 01_initial_revocation_invariant
queries.scope: Initial state satisfies the stated single-session invariant.

queries.name: 02_inductive_revocation_invariant
queries.scope: One-step induction for all modeled actions; combined with 01 gives arbitrary finite traces in this abstraction.

queries.name: 03_no_release_after_revocation
queries.scope: Model release guard disallows revoked grants.

queries.name: 04_no_release_during_checkpoint
queries.scope: Model release guard pauses protected operations during checkpoint.

queries.name: 05_no_release_missing_critical_evidence
queries.scope: All listed modeled critical gates are necessary.

queries.name: 06_no_cross_instance_release
queries.scope: Instance binding in the modeled release rule.

queries.name: 07_expired_grant_cannot_release
queries.scope: Mathematical expiry boundary; clock integrity is assumed.

queries.name: 08_delegation_cannot_amplify
queries.scope: 16-bit set-intersection delegation design. This derivation is specified, not implemented as a complete delegation chain in engine.py.

queries.name: 09_nonvacuous_legitimate_release
queries.scope: Shows the model permits legitimate release; not a deny-all proof.

queries.name: 10_legitimate_admission_reachable
queries.scope: Positive reachability witness for admission.

queries.name: 11_counterexample_missing_authority_gate
queries.scope: Detects omitted authority requirement in a deliberately weakened model.

queries.name: 12_counterexample_revoked_checkpoint_reactivation
queries.scope: Detects a deliberately weakened checkpoint transition.

queries.name: 13_counterexample_cached_authorization_race
queries.scope: A cached initial allow can coexist with revocation before commit; illustrates a race if commit does not recheck.

queries.name: 14_commit_recheck_prevents_modeled_race
queries.scope: With atomic current-state recheck, that particular stale-allow release is excluded. Atomicity is an assumption, not proved for distributed services.

queries.name: 15_identity_binding_required
queries.scope: Tightened release rule requires current instance/key generation binding.

queries.name: 16_task_binding_required
queries.scope: Tightened release rule requires current approved task snapshot.

queries.name: 17_current_epoch_prevents_stale_release
queries.scope: Snapshot equality at atomic release excludes already-committed generation changes. Implementation locking/refinement remains an obligation.

queries.name: 18_counterexample_omitted_identity_binding
queries.scope: An older modeled guard accepts a valid identity proof without current instance binding.

queries.name: 19_global_challenge_quota_preserved
queries.scope: Integer admission guard preserves configured global pending-challenge capacity.

queries.name: 20_per_agent_challenge_quota_preserved
queries.scope: Integer admission guard preserves the per-agent capacity, assuming serialized update.
